critical_code_review_comments: server.py NoteInput.content defaults to empty string; SOAP branch only auto-builds content when 'not doc.get("content")' — good, but if a caller sends note_type='soap' AND a non-empty content, the SOAP fields are stored but content is NOT rebuilt from them. Might be intentional (client-provided override) but worth documenting.
Notes.js: soapText() combiner strips empty lines; a SOAP note with only 1 filled field will still save (empty check uses trim()). This matches backend behavior. Fine.
